title: Cloud Sync & Conflict Health
objective: Memantau sync queue, transfer, retry, conflict, resolution, offline queue, dan duplicate effects.
decision_rule: Tanpa observasi = BLOCKED tanpa klaim kesehatan; cakupan tujuh sinyal belum lengkap atau observasi tanpa catatan = FAIL; sync_success ok sementara transfer_failure failed = FAIL transfer_failure_ignored; sync_success ok sementara queue_age failed = FAIL stale_queue_ignored; sync_success ok sementara duplicate_effect failed = FAIL duplicate_effects_ignored; transfer_failure failed sementara retry_success tidak ok/recovered = FAIL transfer_unrecovered; sync_success failed sementara retry_success tidak ok/recovered = FAIL sync_unrecovered; conflict_rate failed sementara resolution_success failed = FAIL conflict_unresolved; kegagalan terdeteksi yang pulih jujur (retry ok/recovered tanpa pelanggaran) = PASS konsistensi; cakupan lengkap tanpa invalidasi atau pelanggaran = PASS.
limitations: Sinyal dinilai dari observasi lokal/definisi kontrak; cloud sync telemetry workspace produksi live belum diamati.
Injeksi fault jaringan nyata, verifikasi perangkat keras, hosted CI, dan publikasi distribusi tetap DEFERRED-EXTERNAL.
